name: Downsky Causeway V2 · Difficulty 3 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Inspect the drifting terraces, then START CROSSING. Each deliberate tiller action advances one fixed 100 ms physics step; idle time leaves the causeway unchanged. Steer lateral speed with the gold tiller; momentum takes time to reverse. Your whole footprint must fit on a deck. Walking off starts a gravity-driven fall onto a lower deck. Dashed blue outlines show deck positions 0.9 seconds ahead; white streaks show recent drift after each action step. Reach the lit pavilion on terrace 7 and CERTIFY ARRIVAL. A fall below the causeway or early certification ends the episode. Click the tiller rail to steer. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
